basic_details.job_title: IIFT Legal Officer Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: Indian Institute of Foreign Trade (IIFT) has published a notification for the recruitment of 1 Legal Officer vacancy on a contract basis for an initial period of one year. Eligible applicants for the post must possess an LLB Degree with Post Graduation with 55% marks or equivalent CGPA. The notified pay for the position ranges from Rs. 60,000 to Rs. 80,000 per month, depending upon the experience and qualification of the candidate. 50 years as on the date of online application

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates must meet the following essential qualification and experience requirements to apply for the position: Essential Qualification: LLB Degree with Post Graduation securing at least 55% marks or equivalent CGPA. Experience: Extensive experience in handling legal matters in Government Organisations, Government Undertakings/PSUs, Central or State Government Offices, Autonomous Bodies, Universities, or Educational Institutions. This includes service laws, labour laws and codes, land laws, legal drafting and vetting of documents, and liaison with government offices and statutory authorities. A minimum of 5 years of experience working in a similar position in a higher educational institute or institute of repute is required. Skills: Excellent command over English (proficiency in Hindi is preferred) and a working knowledge of computer applications and packages. Desirable Experience: Candidates having work experience as a Senior Legal Associate or Legal Associate from large-scale industries or any law firm which appears in High Courts, PSUs, or similar autonomous institutions of higher education.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The selected candidate will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 60,000 to Rs. 80,000 per month, determined by their experience and qualifications. Higher salaries may be offered to deserving candidates. The appointment is on a contract basis for an initial duration of one year, which may be extended based on performance and institute requirements, up to a maximum total period of four years.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IIFT Legal Officer
content_sections.text: Access the online recruitment portal through the official application link provided below. Complete the online application form with the required personal, educational, and professional details. Submit the application online latest by 27.10.2026.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Fulfillment of educational qualifications and experience does not automatically entitle an applicant to be called for the recruitment process. In case of a large number of applicants, IIFT reserves the right to shortlist applications as appropriate. Only shortlisted candidates will be informed by email to appear for a written test or interaction at the IIFT Campus in New Delhi.

faq.question: Q1. Is this IIFT Legal Officer position permanent or on contract?
faq.answer: The appointment is strictly on a contract basis initially for a period of one year, extendable up to a maximum of four years.

faq.question: Q2. What is the upper age limit for the Legal Officer post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit is 50 years as on the date of the online application.

faq.question: Q3. How will candidates be shortlisted for the selection process?
faq.answer: If there is a large number of applicants, IIFT will shortlist applications appropriately, and only shortlisted candidates will be notified by email for a written test or interaction.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for this position?
faq.answer: Selected candidates are paid a consolidated monthly salary ranging from Rs. 60,000 to Rs. 80,000, depending on experience and qualifications.
